description: Authenticates e-mail that Gavvio sends on the customer's behalf: a DKIM CNAME to a Gavvio-hosted key, a MAIL FROM (bounce) subdomain with its MX and SPF, and a starter DMARC policy that Gavvio only requests when the domain has none. Apply with host= to set up a sending subdomain.
variableDescription: dkimkey: the per-domain DKIM key label Gavvio publishes under dkim.gavvio.com (e.g. claudiabarddal-com-br-4863db6c). region: the AWS SES region that receives bounces for the MAIL FROM MX (e.g. us-east-1).
